evidence_scope: Frozen title and primary abstract only; no full text or external clinical verification.
labeling_method: Assistant read all provided titles and full primary abstracts; one rationale per pair; no Qwen grading run.
limitations: AI judgments are fallible and are not expert-human ground truth.
The annotator had prior conversation context including aggregate method results and one prior supplemental judgment; this is not independent blinded evaluation.
Missing explicit adult ages are flagged with medium confidence rather than treated as confirmed eligibility.
Followed the original query-specific relevance intents; p09 explicitly allows other-age evidence as partial, unlike hard exclusions in some other queries.
Two missing abstracts remain unjudged; metric comparisons containing these pairs are provisional.
